# The Most-Liked TikTok Video of All Time: Bella Poarch’s Viral Success
Bella Poarch’s lip-syncing video to the song “M to the B” by Millie B is the most liked TikTok video of all time. This short little video posted in August 2020 went viral & got almost 50 million likes and made Bella an overnight sensation.

...

Breaking Records and Making History Beyond TikTok, Bella’s lip-sync video became the most liked social media post of 2020 surpassing YouTube’s most liked video at the time, Luis Fonsi’s “Despacito” which had 41 million likes.
TikTok declared it one of the top viral TikTok videos of 2020 and made it into social media history. It’s still one of the most liked TikTok videos and many users consider it the most liked TikTok video to this day.

...

The Future of TikTok Virality Bella Poarch still holds the record for [most liked TikTok video](https://www.themarketingblog.co.uk/2024/06/tiktok-business-vs-creator-account-what-is-the-difference-how-to-choose-what-is-best-for-you/) but new TikTok trends emerge daily.
